body.heading: Where in the world is Saint Lucia?
paragraphs: Saint Lucia is a country in the Caribbean, which is part of North America. It is an island country, surrounded by sea.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Saint Lucia is Castries.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Saint Lucia is English.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Saint Lucia is the East Caribbean dollar.

body.heading: How big is Saint Lucia?
paragraphs: Saint Lucia covers about 616 square kilometres of land and inland water.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: The twin Pitons rise straight from the sea — families explore Soufrière's drive-in volcano, mud baths and waterfalls in their shadow.
Rodney Bay's curve of sand is the island's beach heartland, and Pigeon Island Landmark has forts, ruins and views to Martinique.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Saint Lucia on a map or globe. Which continent is it nearest to — and what sea or ocean surrounds it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
